name: AgentSharingMessages
description:
AgentSharingMessages holds owner-customizable visitor-facing copy for
 shared-agent limit refusals.

 Empty fields mean "use the platform default". Plain text only; rendered
 verbatim in the visitor's chat surface.

fields.name: RateLimited
fields.description: Shown when a visitor or the org exceeds the message rate limit.

fields.name: Unavailable
fields.description: Shown when the org's credits are exhausted (sharing fails closed).

fields.name: ConversationEnded
fields.description: Shown when a conversation hits its turn limit or inactivity timeout.
